slides.title: The trap to avoid
slides.body: Several of the best-known open models are non-commercial — XTTS, F5-TTS, Fish Speech weights. The restriction follows the file, so running them on rented hardware changes nothing.

slides.title: Read the model card
slides.body: Not a blog post, not a video, not me. Licences change between versions — one popular model ships Apache code with non-commercial weights. Check the LICENSE file on the repo you actually download.
